findAnswersClauseverify: Find answers to common questions about clauseverify
faqA1_1: clauseverify is a mobile application that uses AI-powered technology to verify the authenticity and production date of watches, helping collectors and buyers make informed decisions.
faqQ1_2: How do I create an account?
faqA1_2: Tap "Sign Up" on the login screen. Enter your email, create a password, and verify your email address via the link sent to your inbox.
faqA1_3: You can download and register for free. Certain advanced features, like detailed verification reports or unlimited scans, may require a Premium subscription. Check the "Premium" section in the app for details.
faqQ2_1: How does the verification process work?
faqA2_1:
• Use the in-app camera to capture clear photos of the watch (dial, case back, movement if visible).
• Our AI analyzes specific markers, engravings, and craftsmanship details.
• You receive an instant authenticity probability score and a detailed report with supporting evidence.
faqQ2_2: What parts of the watch should I photograph?
faqA2_2:
For best results, provide clear, well-lit images of:
• The watch face (dial)
• The case back
• The Bracelet & Clasp
faqQ2_3: How accurate is the AI verification?
faqA2_3: Our AI is trained on extensive datasets and provides a high-confidence analysis. Important: The result is an assistive tool and probability assessment, not a 100% guaranteed certification. For high-value transactions, we recommend consulting a certified professional.
faqQ2_4: The AI can't identify my watch. What should I do?
faqA2_4: Ensure photos are clear and not blurry. Try different angles and lighting. If the problem persists, the model might not yet be in our database.
faqQ3_1: How do I reset my password?
faqA3_1: On the login screen, tap "Forgot Password." Enter your email to receive a reset link.
faqQ3_2: How do I upgrade to Premium?
faqA3_2: Go to your Profile → "Upgrade to Premium" or "Subscription." Select your plan and follow the payment instructions.
faqQ3_3: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqA3_3: Subscriptions are managed through your device's store (Google Play Store or Apple App Store). Go to your store account settings → Subscriptions to cancel.
faqQ3_4: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
faqA3_4: All your personal data and scan history will be permanently deleted from our servers. This action cannot be undone.
faqQ4_1: The app crashes or freezes. What can I do?
faqA4_1:
• Ensure you have the latest version of the app installed.
• Restart the app and your phone.
• Check your internet connection.
faqQ4_2: I'm having trouble with the camera scan.
faqA4_2:
• Grant the necessary camera permissions in your phone settings.
• Clean your phone's camera lens.
• Avoid scanning in dark or reflective environments.
faqQ5_1: Is my data and photo library secure?
faqA5_1: Yes. We take privacy seriously. All images and data are encrypted and processed securely. We do not share your personal data with third parties without your consent. For details, please read our Privacy Policy.
faqA5_2: No. We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information. Data is used solely to provide and improve the verification service.
privacyPolicyIntro: clauseverify respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is collected, used, and protected when you use the clauseverify application and services.
privacyContent1_1: We may collect the following information:
privacyContent1_2:
a) User Information
• Email address (for account creation and access)
• Subscription status (Free or Premium)
privacyContent1_3:
b) Uploaded Content
• Images of watches uploaded by users for AI analysis
• Optional metadata related to the watch (model, brand, accessories)
privacyContent1_4:
c) Usage Data
• Number of analyses performed
• Dates and times of usage
• Application interactions (for performance and abuse prevention)
privacyContent1_5:
d) Payment Information
• Payments are processed securely via third-party providers (e.g., Stripe)
• clauseverify does not store credit card details
privacyContent2_1:
Your information is used strictly to:
• Provide AI-based pre-expertise analysis of watches
• Generate AI Pre-Expertise Reports
• Manage user accounts and subscriptions
• Monitor usage limits and prevent abuse
• Improve application performance and reliability
• Ensure platform security and cost control
privacyContent3_1:
• Uploaded images may be processed temporarily for analysis purposes
• AI Pre-Expertise Reports may be generated once and not permanently stored
• Minimal metadata (report ID, scores, date) may be retained for verification and security purposes
• Data is retained only as long as necessary to provide the service
privacyContent4_1: We do not sell or rent your personal data.
privacyContent4_2:
Data may be shared only with:
• Trusted third-party service providers (AI APIs, hosting, payment processing)
• Legal authorities if required by law

All third parties are required to comply with strict data protection standards.
privacyContent5_1:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:
• Secure API communication
• Encrypted data transmission
• Access controls and monitoring
• Abuse detection and usage limits

However, no system can be 100% secure.
privacyContent6_1:
By using clauseverify, you agree:
• To upload only images you have the right to use
• Not to misuse the platform or attempt to bypass usage limits
• To accept that AI-based results are informational only
